episodes.title: Offering of Flowers
episodes.summary: Daigo inspects the corpse of a supposed victim of a bear attack but finds something troubling.

episodes.title: Attack
episodes.summary: Daigo runs into Gin's funeral procession and witnesses a shocking accusation.

episodes.title: Fatal Bullet
episodes.summary: Daigo wakes up in the hospital, but danger looms.

episodes.title: Line of Sight
episodes.summary: With the Kano case solved, village life is peaceful for the Agawas at least for now.

episodes.title: Trace
episodes.summary: Daigo is introduced to Utada, who sheds more light on Kano's death and the Kuge Village.

episodes.title: Premonition
episodes.summary: Daigo discovers that Gin Goto suffered from symptoms similar to kuru disease before her death.

episodes.title: Promise
episodes.summary: Daigo is saved by the chief, who sets up a special task force in Kuge Village.

episodes.title: Betrayal
episodes.summary: Daigo reaches where the children are supposed to be held, but they are nowhere to be found.

episodes.title: War
episodes.summary: The Goto family is in a festive mood after hearing Sumire's news, but their joy is soon disrupted.

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.summary: With Yuki and Mashiro held hostage, Daigo grows increasingly unhinged.

episodes.title: Chaos
episodes.summary: Ai Goto lives with a man whose face was devoured, hiding a secret that could expose the Goto family.

episodes.title: Reminiscence
episodes.summary: After Mahiro's kidnapping, Daigo hides Yuki, who lies at death's door, at Kurunokami Shrine.

episodes.title: Uprising
episodes.summary: Gin, who has been thought dead, reappears before the villagers three years after her banishment.

episodes.title: Curse
episodes.summary: Takeru from Kuge Village, a victim of the Goto family's scheme, resolves to seek revenge.

episodes.title: Demise
episodes.summary: Daigo and Keisuke confront That Man. However, Daigo is unable to take action.
